key_points: Q2 revenue +6% YoY to RMB15.7B; international platform >50% growth offsets domestic weakness
Unconfirmed report of RMB5.2B penalty booked - if material would be significant (~$730M), but source is secondary and needs verification
Chinese regulators opened antitrust probes into four major OTA platforms (likely includes Trip.com), creating regulatory overhang
Domestic growth deceleration evident; reliance on international expansion increasing
Near-term focus on penalty clarification and probe developments; international momentum remains key positive
